title: Public Alert No. 018/2025 – Alert on the Ban of Dove Hand and Deodorant Soap due to Butylphenyl Methylpropional (BMHCA) Contamination

products.brand: Dove Men + Care Silver Control Spray

summary: NAFDAC relays an EU ban on certain Dove hand soap and deodorant products found to contain BMHCA, a prohibited cosmetic ingredient linked to reproductive harm and skin sensitization. The products are not in the NAFDAC database; soap imports are prohibited in Nigeria.
